question: Komal is the mother of Neha. Sanaya is the daughter of Chetan. Charu is the mother of Mitra. Chetan is the only son of Komal. Mitra is the son of only son of Komal. How is Charu related to Sanaya?
solution:
By using the following symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aeb5fd489596f1f4556ce0004ccb6d51e844f330d2f6337d3f3497bdfb847707.png] 

As per the given information: ​ 

 
• Komal is the mother of Neha.
 
• Chetan is the only son of Komal. Mitra is the son of only son of Komal. 
 
• Sanaya is the daughter of Chetan. Charu is the mother of Mitra.

​Therefore, the following family tree can be drawn:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42851e4d42328f3cc69dc65d0b4a0c49c06c9e0a69966e7991e0360954f6a638.png] 

Clearly, **Charu is mother of Sanaya.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Mother".
